functions.title: Search approvals
functions.description: List workflow approval tasks assigned to the delegated user (open by default). Returns id, type, title, status and due date only.

completeness.notes: Only tasks assigned to the user or to positions the user holds; at most twenty rows ordered by due date. Request contents and decisions are never included.

functions.declaration: declare function search(args?: { query?: string; status?: 'open' | 'pending' | 'in_progress' | 'approved' | 'rejected' | 'request_info' | 'escalated' | 'cancelled' }): Promise<ApprovalSearchResult>;

functions.title: Search my requests
functions.description: List the workflow requests submitted by the delegated user (My Requests) with state and SLA deadline.

completeness.notes: Only requests opened by the user, newest first, at most twenty rows. Request bodies and workflow context are never included.

functions.declaration: declare function search(args?: { query?: string; state?: 'running' | 'completed' | 'failed' | 'cancelled' }): Promise<RequestSearchResult>;

functions.title: Search notifications
functions.description: List the delegated user's recent in-app notifications (type, title, read state and time only).

completeness.notes: Only the user's own non-expired notifications, newest first, at most twenty rows. Bodies, metadata and links are never included.

functions.declaration: declare function search(args?: { unreadOnly?: boolean }): Promise<NotificationSearchResult>;

functions.title: List pending acknowledgements
functions.description: List issued documents the verified user still has to acknowledge as read, overdue first. Always about the caller only; other people's acknowledgement status is not exposed. Confidential documents are excluded.

completeness.notes: Rows are capped at the requested limit (max 20); partial is true when more pending obligations exist. total is not counted and is null.

functions.declaration: declare function pending(args?: { limit?: number }): Promise<DocAcknowledgementsResult>;

functions.title: Search workflow tasks
functions.description: Search workflow tasks on cases visible to the delegated user, with assignee and SLA state. Read-only.

completeness.notes: Only tasks on cases the user may view. Default status is pending (also matches in_progress); use status 'any' for all. Cannot approve, reject or otherwise act on tasks.

functions.declaration: declare function search(args?: { status?: string; instanceId?: string; assignedToMe?: boolean; overdue?: boolean; limit?: number }): Promise<WorkflowTaskSearchResult>;
